The study validated the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) using self-reported height and weight to assess BMI, finding that body appreciation had a moderate negative relation with BMI and was associated with reduced eating disorder risk factors. The research emphasizes the importance of examining positive aspects of body image and cultural factors, particularly ethnic identity, as protective factors against eating disorders in Black women.
